A few useful answers

Good questions.
Clear next steps.

A little clarity before you get in touch. We’re happy to talk through the details.

All common questions→
Which classes does the school offer?+

Nursery to Class 12, with the RBSE pathway and Science, Commerce and Arts at senior secondary level. Please confirm subject combinations and current availability with the office.

How can I find out about fees?+

Ask the office for the current written fee structure for your child’s class. Our admissions page includes a budget planner for amounts from that quote.

Can we visit before deciding?+

Of course. Call or send an enquiry to ask about a suitable visit time. The office must confirm your visit; submitting an enquiry does not book a slot.

How do we ask about transport?+

Tell the school office your village or area by phone. Confirm route, pickup location, availability and charges directly before making plans.

Have a question about the school?Open the parent guide · four quick answers+
Which class should we ask about first?

Start with Nursery or KG. The office can help decide the appropriate class and explain age eligibility.

See the early-years guide →
What are the current fees?

Fees depend on the class. Ask the office for tuition and any separate costs for books, uniform or transport. The website does not quote official fees.

Contact the office →
How do we visit the campus?

Find the school opposite Mela Ground in Amet. Call before travelling so the office can confirm a suitable time.

Directions and visit details →
What can we choose in Class 11?

Science, Commerce and Arts are the school’s streams. Ask the office to confirm individual subjects, eligibility and availability.

Class 11 guide →

These are public school answers, not a live chat. No questions are recorded. For anything else, call the office.
